name: Arguments
overview: Scripture reveals that arguments often arise from pride and anger, leading to contention and strife, as Proverbs teaches that only pride brings contention and a soft answer can turn away wrath. The Bible warns against quarrelsome behavior both within the church and in marriage, emphasizing the destructive nature of angry and contentious speech. Believers are called to avoid disputations that cause division, instead pursuing peace and unity by doing all things without murmurings or arguing.
